description: This bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations for different models and tags. The horizontal axis represents the categories “case”, “gender”, “tag”, “number”, and “tense”, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “effect”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each category, there are six bars representing the effect for different models: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Each bar is accompanied by an error bar extending vertically from both ends. Within the “case” category, the mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ bars are approximately 6 units in height, while the mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ bars are around 3 units, and the mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ bars reach approximately 11 and 12 units respectively. For “gender”, bar heights range from approximately 1 unit for mBERT-R₂ to 4 units for XLM-L₂. In the “tag” category, the bars are generally shorter, ranging from less than 1 unit to approximately 3 units, while in “number”, the bars range from approximately 1 to 6 units. Lastly, in the “tense” category, the bars range from approximately 1 to 4 units. The bars are not explicitly sorted, and there are no visible visual emphases like shading or outlining applied to any bar.
